description: Compares stated priorities against where time and effort actually went, and produces a strategy drift report. Uses git log, vault priorities, and project docs to detect misalignment. Use when the user says "drift check", "am I on track", "priority alignment", "where did my time go", "strategy drift", or wants to audit focus vs intention.
